svg.title: Known-best packing of 204 unit squares, regularized
svg.desc: A regularized derived view of the retained known-best n=204 construction, never the source witness: its exact frame with the near-axis squares straightened and slid into exact contact, verified over the rationals (atlas/known-best/regularized/index.json), and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer. It changes no side, frontier value or evidence tier; the evidence stated here is the record's.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete d4b8b05 rational centre-basis Witness/v2, read exactly from the retained source file. Finite construction feasibility only; no KKT, local minimum, same-packing, rigidity, novelty, priority or global optimality claim.

svg.text: U n=204 regularized: side ~ 14.807621 (certified upper bound)
